Merlín the duck barred from World Cup stadium due to FIFA rules

Merlín, a duck that has become a viral sensation and folk hero in Mexico, was prevented from entering the stadium for a World Cup match. FIFA's rules regarding animals reportedly led to the decision, meaning Merlín had to watch the game from a distance. The duck's presence near the stadium gained attention ahead of Mexico's match against the Czech Republic.
